solution: Rotated the key with shopctl and restarted orders-api.
short_description: checkout payments failing after the payment api key expired
trigger: The payment-gateway API key expired at 00:00 UTC.
problem_statement: The payment-gateway API key expired at 00:00 UTC. orders-api got 401 from the payment provider for every card payment for 51 minutes, until the key was rotated.
impact_metrics: 51 minutes without card payments. About 1,900 checkout attempts failed.
immediate_resolution: Key rotated and orders-api restarted. Watched the 401 rate fall to zero.

timeline.responsibility: The expiry reminder went to an old mailbox.

timeline.event: On-call found the expired key with shopctl secrets describe.
timeline.action: Paged the payments team on-call for the rotate permission.
Watched the 401 rate fall to zero.

root_causes: The key expiry reminder went to an unmonitored mailbox, so the key expired unnoticed.
Nothing alerted on keys close to expiry.

action_items.action: Send key expiry reminders to the payments team group address.
Alert 14 days before any third-party key expires.
Give the SRE on-call permission to rotate the payment key.
